operations.name: capabilities.get
operations.summary: What this host can do: node types (property types + example), components (props + example), operations, patch ops, backends, easings, formats. Filter with nodeType or component.

operations.name: schema.get
operations.summary: JSON Schema of the Composition IR, of one node type, of the patch format, or of an operation input/output.

operations.name: project.create
operations.summary: Create a project from a template, a JSON project, TSX source, or an empty composition.

operations.name: project.open
operations.summary: Open an existing project folder (openvideo.json or project.json) inside the allowed project roots and return its projectId.

operations.name: project.import
operations.summary: Import SVG, Lottie, glTF, HTML, an anime.js timeline or Motion Canvas scenes into a project; lossy conversions are reported as OV_IMPORT_LOSSY warnings.

operations.name: project.inspect
operations.summary: List projects, or summarize one project (compositions, assets, fonts, profiles).

operations.name: project.update
operations.summary: Replace the whole IR of a JSON project after validation (used by code editors).

operations.name: composition.create
operations.summary: Add a composition to a project.

operations.name: composition.get
operations.summary: Return the IR of a composition.

operations.name: composition.validate
operations.summary: Validate schema, references, fonts, assets and backend capabilities before rendering.

operations.name: composition.patch
operations.summary: Apply semantic patches atomically; TSX projects are updated through AST edits.

operations.name: asset.import
operations.summary: Import a file, URL or base64 data into the project (content-addressed, normalized).

operations.name: asset.inspect
operations.summary: Return metadata of an asset (dimensions, duration, codec, color space, license).

operations.name: frame.render
operations.summary: Render one frame to PNG; returns the image, diagnostics and the frame cache key.

operations.name: frame.renderMany
operations.summary: Render several frames to separate PNGs in one call (e.g. before/after a change); returns one image per frame.

operations.name: frame.inspect
operations.summary: Scene tree with bounds, text layout and diagnostics for one frame (no pixels).

operations.name: preview.render
operations.summary: Render a low-resolution preview video (job).

operations.name: preview.contactSheet
operations.summary: Render several frames into one labeled contact sheet image.

operations.name: video.render
operations.summary: Render the final video with a render profile (job); writes a render manifest.

operations.name: render.status
operations.summary: Status, progress and result of a render job; without jobId, all jobs (optionally of one project), newest first.

operations.name: render.cancel
operations.summary: Cancel a queued or running render job.

operations.name: diagnostics.get
operations.summary: All diagnostics: validation, backend checks, and (with frame) scene diagnostics.

operations.name: subtitles.transcribe
operations.summary: Transcribe an audio/video asset with an ASR provider (e.g. whisper.cpp) into a subtitle track with word timings.

operations.name: fonts.list
operations.summary: List the fonts available to a project (bundled defaults plus project fonts).

operations.name: templates.list
operations.summary: List available templates.

operations.name: templates.inspect
operations.summary: Return the source files and IR of a template.

operations.name: scene.describe
operations.summary: Describe a frame in plain sentences (nodes, positions, text).

operations.name: scene.tree
operations.summary: Scene tree of a frame with bounds and opacity.

operations.name: timeline.inspect
operations.summary: Timing windows, animated properties, keyframe times, markers and tracks.

operations.name: benchmark.run
operations.summary: Run a reproducible benchmark scenario and return the measurements.

operations.name: plugins.list
operations.summary: List the plugins of a project and what they add: agent tools (operations plugin.<name>), codecs, exporters (output formats plugin:<id>), asset loaders and Studio panels.
